# EY – Data Pirate

> > A data analytics blog by Ela Yenikoylu covering R, Python, machine learning, and statistical methods for aspiring data professionals.

Ela Yenikoylu is an MSc Business Analytics candidate sharing practical tutorials on data manipulation, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and machine learning. The site focuses on hands-on examples using R (dplyr, tidyverse), Python (Scikit-Learn), and real-world datasets.

## Key Topics

- R programming
- dplyr & tidyverse
- Python
- Machine learning
- Feature engineering
- Data analysis
- Statistical distributions
- Data sampling
- R Studio
- Scikit-Learn
- Data wrangling
- Statistical methods
- Business analytics
- Ames Housing Dataset

## Core Pages

- [EY – Data Pirate](https://elayenikoylu.com): Homepage featuring data analytics blog with R, dplyr, and tidyverse content
- [About – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/about-2): Bio of Ela Yenikoylu, MSc Business Analytics candidate and data analyst

## R & Data Wrangling Tutorials

- [The Magic of DPLYR – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/2020/12/27/the-magic-of-dplyr): dplyr and tidyverse tutorial for R data manipulation and wrangling
- [Data Sampling Using R Studio – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/2020/10/26/data-sampling-using-r-studio): Data sampling tutorial using R Studio for statistical methods and machine learning

## Machine Learning & Feature Engineering

- [Machine Learners: Feature Engineering – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/2021/02/24/machine-learners-feature-engineering): Feature engineering tutorial using Python, Scikit-Learn, and Ames Housing Dataset

## Statistical Analysis

- [Statistical Distributions: Does Normal Distribution Exist in Real World? – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/2020/11/18/statistical-distributions-does-normal-distribution-exist-in-real-world): Statistical distributions analysis covering normal, uniform, and exponential distributions

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog – EY](https://elayenikoylu.com/blog): Blog archive featuring machine learning and data analysis tutorials
